summary: Iteration 34 - Security Auth Features Testing. All 5 security features verified: 1) POST /api/auth/register returns 403 (direct registration disabled), 2) POST /api/auth/request-password-reset returns generic message (no email enumeration), 3) POST /api/auth/login verifies subscription status, 4) /register page redirects to /pricing, 5) /login page shows 'Démarrer l'essai gratuit' instead of 'Créer une entreprise'. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI tests passed.

issues: Cookie consent dialog overlays the page - minor UX issue but not blocking
